Disorders of Carbohydrate 
Metabolism
Disorders of carbohydrate metabolism include problems with 
processing the simple sugars galactose and fructose in the body, 
and a group of disorders called glycogen storage diseases that
result in various defects in synthesizing and releasing glucose.
Table 26.15 summarizes the carbohydrate disorders to be 
discussed here, along with their main clinical symptoms and
available treatments. Prompt diagnosis and dietary treatment 
signiﬁ cantly help to improve the overall outcome for patients
aﬀ ected with one of these types of conditions.
